name: Petro-Victory Energy Corp.
summary: Petro-Victory Energy Corp., an entity headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, specializes in the discovery, growth, and extraction of crude oil and natural gas resources. Operating through its various subsidiaries, the company possesses active stakes in 38 permits, encompassing a total of 257,604 acres within two productive Brazilian oil basins. The firm itself was established in 2014.
